authority: reviewer 2026-09-19: stop describing this as a global oscillator, it is parallel local oscillators with nearly identical frequency. The problem has moved from O and X back inside the definition of CTX[jomission_v0], and that must be answered before changing HDP, tonic drive, delays or any inter-area parameter. Authorized in manifests/todo.json as SCI-WS-OSC-1, next_authorized_task at seal time
question: x : CTX : y -- does the burst mode require local E->E recurrence?

SINGLE_AREA.meaning: the intact control, identical to the WS-AUTH-2 g = 0 construction

EE_CUT.meaning: every within-area E->E weight set to exactly 0.0, nothing else changed

principal_delta: local E->E weight set to 0.0 in the EE_CUT arm. E->I, I->E, I->I, the retinal interface, the long-range edges and every other array are the intact arm's. No recurrence beyond local E->E is ablated

shared_regime.why: both arms run fully disconnected, the condition WS-AUTH-2 sealed, so the six cortical objects are independent and no inter-area path can carry a mode between them. This makes the E->E cut the single principal delta rather than one of two. It is an interpretive choice made before execution and declared here: at g > 0 a surviving mode could be imported from a neighbouring area, and the arms would differ in two ways
shared_regime.consequence: the verdict is scoped to the disconnected regime. It does not establish what the coupled system does, and must not be read as if it did

estimator.status: NEW. No sealed period estimator existed in this project before this lineage
estimator.finding_that_required_it: WS-AUTH-2's OBSERVED claim that the pooled E burst period is 190 ms, 5.26 Hz, with autocorrelation 0.895 cites results/whole_system_authority_g000.json. That file's top-level keys contain no period, frequency or autocorrelation field, and no module in this repository computed one. The 190 ms figure therefore has no receipt. This lineage does not inherit it: the SINGLE_AREA arm re-measures the mode it compares against
estimator.definition: peak_autocorr is the largest autocorrelation of the mean-removed population rate at a lag beyond the first zero crossing; period_ms is that lag. A mode is present when peak_autocorr exceeds the null threshold
estimator.null: the 95th percentile of the same statistic over Poisson surrogates matched to the signal's own mean rate and cell count, so the floor is computed rather than chosen
estimator.validated_by: tests/test_oscillation.py, which recovers planted 95, 190 and 250 ms periods
estimator.signal: per-area E population rate in Hz, 1 ms bins, spike-count weighted across that area's E layers -- the same series the gates read. Reported per area because WS-AUTH-2 established these are parallel local oscillators, not one global one. The pooled series is recorded alongside and is not the primary observable

oscillation.window_meaning: the final 1000 ms of the 13000 ms run, which is 1000 ms after the stimulus ends, so the measured mode is the resting mode
oscillation.max_lag_meaning: 500 ms admits any period from 2 Hz upward inside a 1000 ms window

predeclared_outcomes.CONTROL_HAS_NO_MODE: the intact arm shows no mode above its own null. The lineage then says nothing about recurrence and the result is about the estimator or the control
predeclared_outcomes.MODE_REQUIRES_ABLATED_CONNECTION: the mode is present intact and falls into the null when E->E is cut
predeclared_outcomes.MODE_INDEPENDENT_OF_ABLATED_CONNECTION: the mode survives at the same period within 10 percent, which points at intrinsic single-cell dynamics
predeclared_outcomes.MODE_DEPENDS_QUANTITATIVELY: the mode survives but its period moves by more than 10 percent
predeclared_outcomes.committed: no outcome is preferred. The interval is reported and no winner is selected

frozen.inherits: everything results/whole_system_authority_bracket_spec.json froze, including architecture, realizer, tonic drive, dt, seed, weight, probability and mechanism taus
frozen.stimulus: on, the sealed retinal spot, identical in both arms

duration.derivation: the baseline kernel enables no HDP, so the slowest enabled relevant state is the Izhikevich recovery variable u at a = 0.02, tau approximately 50 ms; AMPA is 2 ms and GABA_A 5 ms. Settle is 40x the slowest enabled time constant. The post-stimulus interval is twice the stimulus so offset transients, runaway and drift each have room to appear after the drive is removed. Settle is extended to 10 s on the WS-DIAG-1 observation that the network had not stopped evolving at 5 s; this is a horizon correction, not a parameter tuning, and no mechanism, weight or drive is changed

duration.unchanged: stimulus 1000 ms and post-stimulus 2000 ms are exactly as sealed in WS-DIAG-1

additive_changes: --ee-cut, which zeroes every within-area E->E weight after enforcement and after EQUAL_G realization and before compilation, and records what it zeroed

relation_to_parent: WS-AUTH-2 established that six fully disconnected areas keep the mode, moving the question inside one cortical object. This lineage asks whether the mode inside that object requires local E->E recurrence
sealed_before_execution: this file is committed and pushed before either arm runs
runtime_blocks_copied_verbatim_from_pare: duration, kernel, gates and frozen.tonic are copied byte-for-byte from results/whole_system_authority_bracket_spec.json so this driver reads one sealed file. tests assert the copy is identical to the parent block

Settle is 40x the slowest enabled time constant. The post-stimulus interval is twice the stimulus so offset transients, runaway and drift each have room to appear after the drive is removed. Settle is extended to 10 s on the WS-DIAG-1 observation that the network had not stopped evolving at 5 s; this is a horizon correction, not a parameter tuning, and no mechanism, weight or drive is changed
duration.not_chosen_for_reassurance: no interval is longer than the failure class it must expose
duration.unchanged: stimulus 1000 ms and post-stimulus 2000 ms are exactly as sealed in WS-DIAG-1

kernel.reason: the qualified scientific lineage (V2.1 and the whole PV chain) executed kernel=baseline. jomission_sat_ee_v0 was qualified on star-column geometry and never on a multi-area composition, so running it here would confound the architecture with an unqualified rule transplanted to a new topology
kernel.H_recording: H, Theta and w_eff are recorded as realized. Under the baseline kernel they are expected static; a static trace is reported as static and is not evidence of stabilization
kernel.hdp_off_reason: HDP is OFF so that long-range authority is the single principal delta. Reviewer 2026-09-18: after locating the operating regime, then turn the repaired H-homeostasis back on and ask whether HDP extends and stabilizes the viable coupling range. That is a later lineage.

gates.rule: report the earliest load-bearing failure in this order; a later gate is not evaluated as the primary verdict once an earlier one fails

execution.criterion: every recorded v, u and current is finite for every step

collapse.criterion: in the final 1000 ms, every area's E population rate is at least 0.1 Hz

runaway.criterion: no class population rate exceeds 200 Hz sustained for 100 ms, and f_active does not reach 1.0 sustained for 100 ms

synchrony.criterion: for every area's E population, std/mean of the 1 ms-binned population rate over the final 1000 ms is at most 3.0
synchrony.estimator: coefficient of variation of the 1 ms population rate; predeclared before execution

drift.criterion: over the final 1500 ms of the post-stimulus interval, the least-squares slope of each area's E population rate in 100 ms bins satisfies |slope| <= 0.5 Hz/s, OR the slope is not sustained
drift.sustained_rule: a slope counts as drift only if the first and second halves of that window both exceed the tolerance with the same sign. A slow transient that is decaying fails the sustained test and is not drift
drift.predeclared: estimator and tolerance fixed before execution and not adjustable afterwards

propagation.criterion: the stimulus changes the E population rate at every hierarchical level: V1.1, at least one V4, and at least one of FEF/PFC. A change counts when the stimulus-window rate differs from the settle baseline by more than max(1 Hz, 10% of baseline)
propagation.band_authority: the sealed V2.1 band convention max(1 Hz, 10%), reused unchanged
propagation.lateral_probe: the spot lies entirely in the left hemifield, so any V1.2 change is transfer through X[lat] or the V4 level, and is reported separately rather than counted toward propagation
